an4.230:1.1: hoti, dussīlo hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti . . . pe . . . . . . saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca pasavatīti.
